recurrent neural networks can recover both neural representation and the structural organization of neural circuits.
recurrent neural networks can learn both neural representations and anatomical organization of neural circuits.
recurrent neural networks can recover both neural activity and the anatomical properties (structure and function) of the head direction neural circuit.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how the brain computes the location of an animal in its environment.
the emergence of functional and structural features of neural networks by training them in a goal-driven manner.
the question of what makes the brain so efficient and robust in its function.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the goal-driven optimization of RNN architecture in a task of estimating the head direction can recapitulate both functional and structural properties observed in biological neural circuits.
the results show that the optimization of RNN can recapitulate structure and function of the brain.
we can use artificial neural networks to model the brain at both the functional and structural level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

recurrent neural networks trained to perform head direction estimation in an unsupervised manner, can recapitulate both the functional and structural properties observed in biological head direction circuits.
recurrent neural networks trained in a goal-driven manner can recapitulate both neural representations and anatomical connectivity of a brain circuit.
recurrent neural networks can be trained to recover both neural representations of the head direction network and its anatomical structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
recurrent neural networks can recover the functional and structural properties that have been characterized for the head direction system of the brain.
recurrent neural networks can be optimized to recover the structure and function in neural circuits, and this can be used to better understand the biological circuits.
recurrent neural networks can learn the functional and anatomical properties of the head-direction system.
